description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. R. D. Wimaladasa as a member of the Seventh Parliament for the Electoral District No. 15 - Kurunegala
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to the death of an elected member and the declaration of a new member elected to fill that vacancy. This directly relates to electoral processes and parliamentary membership declarations, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including candidate registrations, election results, and declarations.
